name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.SealedRow.selected_phase_parity
title: Rounding the sum of selected scalar LWE phases recovers the affine tape parity
statement: For at most 129 selected components, each integer error bounded by 63 in absolute value, a single rounding of the aggregated phase modulo 32768 returns the parity of the selected bits. Arbitrary wrap multiples and dot products are allowed.
